_about: Target-measurement calibration for the live viewer (processing.targets). Edit and restart the viewer server. Values marked calibrated=false are assumptions, and the UI labels results from them as uncalibrated.

range.basis: Three-point corner-reflector fit 2026-10-07 at the stock 204.3 MHz sweep: distance = 0.75 m x bin + 0.14 m (+/-10%). Scaled by 204.3/240.3 for the installed 240 MHz sweep (stretch x1.18 measured). Re-measure at 240 MHz.
range._sweep_step: Rise step (register 0x56) at which m_per_bin applies. When the viewer has read or written a different live 0x56 since the last re-init, m_per_bin is scaled by sweep_step/live step.

angle.basis: Assumed half-wavelength receiver spacing; boresight offset and sign not yet measured (RX2-RX1 phase was -5 to +9 deg for a reflector straight ahead on 2026-10-07).

velocity.basis: Positive Doppler bin reported as positive velocity; which direction that is has not been checked.

detection._cells: [range bins, Doppler bins]. Threshold is over the cell-averaging CFAR noise estimate. min_doppler_bin applies only when static removal is on.
detection._threshold: 2026-10-08: noise-only false alarms are rare even at 8 dB (one beyond 2.7 m in 111 frames of output/live_radar/20261008-030525-capture-51fbe3); 10 dB keeps margin and the tracker rejects one-frame alarms. Thermal noise alone would allow about 7 dB for 1e-3 per cell.
detection._clutter: Clutter map: exponential average of each range-Doppler cell's power from zero (time constant clutter_tau_s, 0 disables). Range bins near a confirmed, not-in-place track younger than censor_s are not updated, so walkers are not learned. A detection must exceed the map by clutter_threshold_db. Persistent returns fade out within about 8 s of start or a settings change. 2026-10-08: removes persistent lines at multiples of ~102 Hz at 1.2-1.8 m (output/live_radar/20261008-113257-capture-7cd819; nothing moving in view).

tracking._about: Constant-velocity Kalman tracks (processing.Tracker). Confirmed after confirm_hits detections in confirm_frames frames; coast_s bridges missed frames; gate_chi2 is the 2-D Mahalanobis gate (13.8 = 99.9%); detections within cluster_range_m and cluster_deg count as one object; in_place marks Doppler at least in_place_min_mps with a range rate under in_place_ratio of it (fans, fidgeting). While coasting, velocity decays with coast_velocity_tau_s; speed is capped at max_speed_mps; tracks beyond max_angle_deg or max_range_m + 0.5 m end.
